answer: Require every agent identity to be bound to one hardware attestation key that cannot be cloned, like a marble slab cut only once: the enclave signs each action, and the public ledger mirrors that signature so duplicates are visible instantly. Creating a fake means buying another real device and passing a live liveness check, not copying a file. A plume of cheap copies collapses because each Sybil needs its own paid device, while one honest agent needs only one.
